method.divisor_lattice_gate: recover the graph action in the archived integral NS curve basis; verify unimodularity, order two, isometry, and every wall image
method.finite_volume_gate: Vinberg elliptic-edge endpoint criterion with full parabolic zero-neighborhood audit and complete simple-root hard gate
method.fold: orbit-sum Gram on the graph-isometry fixed subspace
method.integral_reflection_gate: fixed (-2)-root, or disjoint two-cycle with orbit norm -4
method.irredundancy_gate: all projective extreme rays enumerated exactly; equality rays span each facet hyperplane and a strict ray exists

scope: all nonidentity weighted-wall-graph involutions in rho=15,16,17; full exact geometry for conjugacy classes with fixed H-dimension >9

source_action_evidence.rank15: Aut(weighted graph)=S3 x Z/2; only the central Z/2 graph reflection is symplectically realized.
source_action_evidence.rank16: Aut(weighted graph)=(Z/2)^2; tau_1 is realized, while tau_2 is excluded because it fixes fifteen rational curves.
source_action_evidence.rank17: the unique graph involution is symplectically realized

summary.novelty_status: unresolved; these exact folded polytopes are not claimed new

surface_realization_warning: A symmetry of the complete weighted curve graph induces an exact rational isometry of the divisor span and hence a Coxeter fixed slice, but need not be induced by an automorphism of the selected K3 surface.  Special-period realization requires a separate Torelli/discriminant-form argument.
